prompt.project_info: Create a luxury fashion-editorial studio image with a surreal oversized footwear set piece.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with an approved adult face-and-style reference sits elegantly inside the opening of a giant brown leather high-heel shoe. She wears a fully covered cream fashion mini-dress with delicate hanging embellishments, dark sunglasses, layered jewelry, and holds a small sculptural red handbag.
prompt.composition_elements: The giant shoe dominates the foreground, with realistic leather grain, stitching, sole, and heel construction; the model is seated inside the shoe opening against a clean white background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio lighting, bright seamless white environment, polished luxury fashion photography mood.
prompt.technical_specs: High-detail editorial photography, realistic leather texture and stitching, natural anatomy, clean product-focused composition, sharp subject and shoe detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Surreal luxury fashion editorial studio image of an adult woman with an approved adult face-and-style reference sitting elegantly inside the opening of a giant brown leather high-heel shoe. The shoe has detailed leather grain, realistic stitching, a sculptural platform and tall heel. She wears a fully covered cream fashion mini-dress with delicate hanging embellishments, dark sunglasses, layered jewelry, and holds a small red sculptural handbag. Clean white background, soft diffused lighting, refined luxury fashion photography.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, exact facial identity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, malformed hands, warped shoe, watermark, logo, text, signature
